auditor_value: shortest distance = 5√2 km ≈ 7.07 km, reached after 0.25 h = 15 minutes

findings.note: Step 1 gives v_A = (−20, 0) km/h, so the east component of v_B − v_A is 0 − (−20) = 20, not 0 − (−40). As printed the line is arithmetically false: 0 − (−40) = 40, yet it is set equal to 20. The final vector (20, 20) and everything after it are correct, so the error is confined to this line, but a student copying it would either carry 40 km/h eastward or conclude that 0 − (−40) = 20.

notes: Independent check (B at origin, A at (0, 10) km, north = +y, west = −x): r_A(t) = (−20t, 10), r_B(t) = (0, 20t), so d² = 800t² − 400t + 100, minimised at t = 1/4 h = 15 min with d² = 50, d = 5√2 ≈ 7.07 km. A perpendicular-distance check on the relative path gives the same 5√2 km and 15 min. The final answer agrees with mine; steps 0 and 2–5 are all correct.
